title: Cyclic plain-object/array properties overflow the scrub stack — the diff adds the tag guard but no cycle protection
evidence:
<> "if(!o||typeof o!=='object')return o;"
        <> "var ts=Object.prototype.toString.call(o);"
        <> "if(ts!=='[object Object]'&&ts!=='[object Array]')return o;"
        <> "for(var k in o){var v=o[k];"
        <> "if(/resume-token/i.test(k)){o[k]='<redacted>';}"
        <> "else if(typeof v==='string'){o[k]=v.replace(re,'$1<redacted>');}"
        <> "else if(v&&typeof v==='object'){scrub(v);}}"
detail: A self-referencing property (p.self = p) passes the plain-object/array guard and recurses until RangeError, aborting capture. Verified against shipped bytes: 'cycle: RangeError Maximum call stack size exceeded'. Pre-existing, but the new guard adds no visited-set.
recommended_fix: Track visited objects in a WeakSet inside scrub and return o when already seen, so a cycle degrades to a no-op instead of a stack overflow.

title: Guard classifies by Symbol.toStringTag, an own/inherited overridable signal — mis-handles tag-carrying objects in both directions
evidence:
<> "var ts=Object.prototype.toString.call(o);"
        <> "if(ts!=='[object Object]'&&ts!=='[object Array]')return o;"

scripts/js-tests/apply_event_scrub.test.js:135-136:
  Object.defineProperty(el, Symbol.toStringTag, {
    value: "HTMLDivElement",
detail: Verified against shipped bytes: a plain data object carrying own or inherited Symbol.toStringTag='HTMLDivElement' is returned untouched, so its attr__data-resume-token value ('SECRET') and /resume/ URL leak — the pre-fix scrub redacted both (redaction regression). Conversely a host-ish object with tag 'Object' is recursed and its outerText setter fires (form-collapse mechanism reachable).
recommended_fix: Corroborate the tag with a prototype check (Object.getPrototypeOf(o) is Object.prototype or Array.prototype, or null) before recursing, so tag-spoofed data objects are still scrubbed and tagged host objects stay untouched.
